message: No detected input validation: The code only checks whether the request is JSON (is_json), but performs no validation of structure, key presence, data types, shape, or value ranges on the incoming payload before passing it to the model.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local CSV file path with no checksum verification, signature validation, or any integrity check on the source file.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only prints class counts but performs no validation of label values against an expected set, no distribution comparison, and no label-noise detection tool is used.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data loading in utils.py simply reads the CSV and extracts values with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads the serialized model with `joblib.load(PICKLE_DIR)` without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity before use.
No detected label distribution validation: The code prints fraud/valid counts but does not validate, assert, or enforce any class balance threshold or expected label set before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanism is imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or techniques (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are used anywhere in the pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: The train/test split is done in the same function as training with no isolation guarantee, there is no signing or hashing of evaluation data, and although multiple metrics exist in the scores() function it is never actually called during training.

No detected input sanitization: The code only checks that the request is JSON and extracts 'data', but performs no shape validation, range/type checks, or schema enforcement before passing data to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: Predictions and confidence scores are returned directly without any NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or threshold sanity validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a tabular classifier (Random Forest/Logistic Regression/LinearSVC), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
